article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 24 Master Broadcasts Dated Across United Nations Radio, Treasury Song Parade, and Sons of the Pioneers
article-meta.kwd-group: UN Radio, Helen Hayes, Ronald Colman, Treasury Song Parade, Mildred Bailey, Sons of the Pioneers, Bob Nolan, Original Filenames

sec.title: Batch 28 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 28 resolves 24 historical master recordings across three historic radio collections: 9 post-war documentary and dramatic transcriptions from ***United Nations Radio*** (starring Helen Hayes, Ronald Colman, Eddie Albert, and Clifton Fadiman), 10 wartime 1943 musical broadcasts of the US Treasury Department's ***Treasury Song Parade*** (featuring Mildred Bailey, Connie Haines, Georgia Gibbs, and Jessica Dragonette), and 5 classic master recordings of the ***Sons of the Pioneers*** (including their 1951 *Lucky U Ranch* Mutual network premiere with Bob Nolan and 1954 *Smokey Bear* public service transcriptions alongside Tennessee Ernie Ford and Robert Cummings).
